item.title: Baqaei: European countries that placed their facilities at disposal of aggressor must be held accountable
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Referring to the explicit demands made of European capitals during yesterday’s meeting between the Foreign Minister and foreign ambassadors and heads of diplomatic missions, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said that very single European country that placed its territory or facilities at the disposal of the aggressors must be held accountable for its actions; for this constitutes a clear instance of participation and complicity in the crime of international aggression and the use of force against an independent state and UN member.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86284341/Baqaei-European-countries-that-placed-their-facilities-at-disposal

Tehran, IRNA – Referring to the explicit demands made of European capitals during yesterday’s meeting between the Foreign Minister and foreign ambassadors and heads of diplomatic missions, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said that very single European country that placed its territory or facilities at the disposal of the aggressors must be held accountable for its actions; for this constitutes a clear instance of participation and complicity in the crime of international aggression and the use of force against an independent state and UN member.

item.title: Iran warns of different response to attacks launched from regional territory
item.description: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has stressed that the region has had bitter experiences with the US military presence and its interventions. “We must all bear in mind that we are permanent neighbors,” he said, urging regional countries, particularly those that provided their facilities for Israeli attacks on Iran, to reconsider such actions. Baqaei warned that any action originating from the territory of regional countries would be met with a different kind of response.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86284110/Iran-warns-of-different-response-to-attacks-launched-from-regional

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has stressed that the region has had bitter experiences with the US military presence and its interventions. “We must all bear in mind that we are permanent neighbors,” he said, urging regional countries, particularly those that provided their facilities for Israeli attacks on Iran, to reconsider such actions. Baqaei warned that any action originating from the territory of regional countries would be met with a different kind of response.
